title: Single-Pass Inventory Engine
objective: Build a fast, evidence-rich inventory that scans once and never equates unknown with safe.

stories.title: FileFacts inventory model
stories.outcome: Collect logical size, allocated/physical estimate, timestamps, type, identity, boundary, provider/category hints, and scan confidence.
acceptance_criteria: Facts distinguish logical from reclaimable/allocated estimates when supported.
Unsupported metrics are explicit null/unknown values.
verification: Platform fixture tests and filesystem golden snapshots.

stories.title: One traversal per scope
stories.outcome: Replace repeated recursive size walks with a reusable inventory pass.
acceptance_criteria: Traversal count is observable in benchmarks.
verification: Benchmark fixture proves bounded traversal count independent of report views.

stories.title: Incomplete inventory propagation
stories.outcome: Propagate permission, disappearance, I/O, and unsupported filesystem states into completeness metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Every inventory scope is COMPLETE, PARTIAL, or UNKNOWN with reasons.
verification: Permission and race fixtures across nested directories.

stories.title: Performance budget baseline
stories.outcome: Establish scan latency, memory, CPU, and cancellAI self-footprint budgets on representative datasets.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmarks include 10k, 100k, and 1M-entry synthetic datasets where feasible.
Regression thresholds are recorded and CI-friendly microbenchmarks are separated from scheduled heavy benchmarks.
verification: Scheduled benchmark workflow produces machine-readable trend artifact.
